description: This PHP test class `PayGradeAllowedCurrencyAPITest` is a unit testing class for the API `PayGradeAllowedCurrencyAPI` in the OrangeHRM system. It sets up test data, mocks services, and verifies endpoints related to allowed currencies for pay grades within the HRM system, focusing on API functionality and validation.
